common_pattern: All 3 FN cases share the same root cause: CaseExecutionSpec lacks explicit ActorContext. Execution uses a hardcoded global identity that does not exercise the specific actor/tenant/role boundary required by each vulnerability mechanism.
unified_fix_required: Introduce explicit ActorContext model to CaseExecutionSpec, remove hardcoded global identity from CandidateExecutionLayer, and propagate actor/tenant/role from case specification through execution.
drift_status: The original 18/50 drift is UNVERIFIED for cases outside the pilot set. Investigation focused on the 3 pilot FN cases only.
